title: 'सेतो धरती' उपन्यासमा भाषिक विचलन
nepali: यो लेख अमर न्यौपानेद्वारा लिखित 'सेतो धरती' उपन्यासमा प्रयुक्त अग्रभूमिनिर्माण अन्तर्गत रहेर भाषिक विचलनमा आधारित छ । अग्रभूमिनिर्माणका प्रमुख उपकरण समानान्तरता र विचलन मध्ये यहाँ विचलनको परिचय दिई सेतो धरती उपन्यासमा रहेको भाषिक विचलनको विश्लेषण गर्नु यस लेखको प्रमुख उद्देश्य हो । पुस्तकालयीय अध्ययन विधिबाट तथ्य सङ्कलन गरी सेतो धरती उपन्यासलाई प्राथमिक स्रोत तथा सैद्धान्तिक पुस्तकहरूलाई द्वितीयक स्रोतका रूपमा लिइएको यस लेखमा वर्णनात्मक विधिको उपयोग भएको छ । विश्लेष्य उपन्यासमा मानक व्याकरणका मान्यतामा सीमित नबनी साहित्यिक कृतिलाई कलात्मक र सार्थक तुल्याउन शैलीविज्ञानमा स्थापित अग्रभूमि निर्माणका समानान्तर र विचलनअन्तर्गत विचलनको यथोचित उपयोग गरिएको पाइयो । उपन्यासमा प्रयुक्त भाषा पात्रानुकूल नै पाइन्छ । विश्लेष्य उपन्यासमा भाषिका, ध्वनि प्रक्रियात्मक, अर्थतात्विक, व्याकरणिक, पदक्रम र आदर विचलन मध्ये भाषिक विचलन अधिक रहेछ भन्ने देखियो जसले उपन्यास थप कलात्मक बनेको छ । साहित्यको समालोचनामा भाषिक विचलनको यो विश्लेषण एउटा नवीन आयाम हुन सक्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ ।
american_english: This article is based on linguistic deviation under foregrounding as used in the novel 'Seto Dharti' written by Amar Neupane. Among the main tools of foregrounding, parallelism and deviation, introducing deviation and analyzing the linguistic deviation present in the novel Seto Dharti is the main objective of this article. In this article, in which data were collected through the library research method, taking the novel Seto Dharti as the primary source and theoretical books as the secondary source, the descriptive method has been used. It was found that in the novel under analysis, not limited to the norms of standard grammar, deviation was appropriately used under parallelism and deviation established in stylistics to make the literary work artistic and meaningful. The language used in the novel is found to be character-appropriate. In the novel under analysis, among dialectal, phonological, semantic, grammatical, word-order and honorific deviations, linguistic deviation was found to be more prevalent, which has made the novel more artistic. It is expected that this analysis of linguistic deviation in literary criticism can be a new dimension.

informal_english: This article looks at the linguistic deviation in Amar Neupane's novel 'Seto Dharti', under foregrounding. Of foregrounding's two main tools — parallelism and deviation — the idea here is to introduce deviation and analyse the linguistic deviation in Seto Dharti. Data was collected through library study, with the novel as the primary source and theory books as secondary, and a descriptive method was used. In the novel, not sticking to standard grammar rules, deviation has been used fittingly under parallelism and deviation from stylistics to make the work artistic and meaningful. The language in the novel turns out to be true to the characters. Among dialectal, phonological, semantic, grammatical, word-order and honorific deviations, linguistic deviation shows up the most, and that's what makes the novel more artistic. This analysis of linguistic deviation in literary criticism could well open up a new dimension, and that's the hope.
